Cancellation propagation
every task honors CancelledError
cleanup in finally — no orphans

span.p:
Graceful shutdown
stop intake -> drain queues ->
checkpoint -> cancel tasks
no accepted event lost

Root supervisor
structured task tree · per-task restart policy
failures surface loudly, never swallowed
